item.title: Slap Bass Legend Lee Rocker Hits the Road as The Stray Cats Announce 2026 Tour
item.description: The Stray Cats have announced a 2026 U.S. tour after canceling last year’s dates due to Brian Setzer’s health. Slap bass master Lee Rocker returns to anchor the rockabilly trio.

item.title: Watch: Nathan East Brings Upright Bass to Clapton’s “Black Magic Woman”
item.description: With Nathan East on upright bass, Eric Clapton’s “Black Magic Woman” takes on a relaxed blues feel before the band lets it unfold into a jam.

item.title: Sadowsky Reveals 2026 Limited Edition Vintage P/J Bass in MetroLine & Masterbuilt Series
item.description: Sadowsky has unveiled its 2026 limited edition Vintage P/J bass in MetroLine and Masterbuilt versions, featuring chambered Okoume bodies and spalted maple tops.

item.title: Marc Brownstein Discusses The Disco Biscuits’ Allen Aucoin Split on Andy Frasco’s Emergency Podcast
item.description: Marc Brownstein discusses The Disco Biscuits’ split with Allen Aucoin during Andy Frasco’s emergency podcast, sharing his perspective on the band’s breakup.

item.title: Modest Mouse Return With First New Song in Five Years, “Look How Far…,” and Announce Summer Tour
item.description: Modest Mouse have released their first new song in five years, “Look How Far…,” and announced a new run of North American tour dates for summer 2026.

item.title: Thundercat Conjures a Cosmic Groove on “ThunderWave” with WILLOW
item.description: Thundercat and WILLOW float through “ThunderWave” in this dreamy live session, trading vocals, stacking harmonies, and leaving plenty of room for a fluid bass solo.

item.title: Three-Note Sequence Bass Exercise to Sync Your Fretting and Plucking Hands
item.description: Ryan Madora shares a three-note sequence bass exercise that improves fretting and plucking hand synchronization while building technique and fretboard control.

item.title: Tony Levin and Stick Men Announce 2026 North American “Brutal” Tour
item.description: Tony Levin and Stick Men have announced a 2026 North American tour supporting their latest EP, "Brutal." The trio featuring Levin, Markus Reuter, and Pat Mastelotto will perform across the U.S. and Canada this spring.

item.title: MonoNeon Brings the Funk at Yoshi’s with “Tell Me That This Love Ain’t Real”
item.description: MonoNeon hits Yoshi’s in Oakland with “Tell Me That This Love Ain’t Real,” blending deep pocket, quirky phrasing, and the fearless style he’s known for.

item.title: Sire Unveils New Gen Marcus Miller Basses With Lighter Hardware and Reworked Electronics
item.description: Sire has updated its Marcus Miller bass lineup with the New Gen series, bringing revised neck profiles, lighter hardware, reworked electronics, and improved weight consistency to the V3, V7, V7 Vintage, and P7.
